prompt.en: Which sentence is correct: 'The king told Rama that he was clever.' or 'The king said Rama that he was clever.'?
prompt.hi: 'Said' aur 'told' mein farak — kis ke saath person ka naam seedha aata hai?

challenges.hint: One of these verbs needs a person right after it.

options.text: The king told Rama that he was clever.
The king said Rama that he was clever.

challenges.keyText: The king told Rama that he was clever.

prompt.en: Read this scene: 'GOPAL (holding a bucket): Seth-ji, I paid you fifty coins for this well. Why do you stop me from drawing water? / SETH (folding his arms): I sold you the well, Gopal, not the water inside it.' How much did Gopal pay for the well?
prompt.hi: Scene suno. Gopal ne kuan kitne mein khareeda tha?

challenges.hint: It is a number of coins.

prompt.en: Which sentence shows that the injury came BEFORE the battle? (a) 'His arm was injured when the battle began.' (b) 'His arm had been injured before the battle began.'
prompt.hi: Dono mein se kaunsa saaf batata hai ki chot pehle lagi thi, ladai baad mein?

challenges.hint: 'Had + verb' marks the earlier of two past events.

options.text: (a) 'His arm was injured when the battle began.'
(b) 'His arm had been injured before the battle began.'

challenges.keyText: (b) 'His arm had been injured before the battle began.'

prompt.en: Which is the best topic sentence for a descriptive paragraph about a hill town? (a) The air smells of pine trees. (b) Mussoorie is a cool, green town in the hills. (c) We bought hot corn near the market.
prompt.hi: Hill town ke baare mein descriptive paragraph likhna hai. Inmein se best topic sentence kaunsa hai? (a) The air smells of pine trees. (b) Mussoorie is a cool, green town in the hills. (c) We bought hot corn near the market.

challenges.hint: A topic sentence names the place and the big idea, not one small fact.

options.text: (a) The air smells of pine trees.
(b) Mussoorie is a cool, green town in the hills.
(c) We bought hot corn near the market

challenges.keyText: (b) Mussoorie is a cool, green town in the hills.

prompt.en: Pick the best closing line for this paragraph: 'The Diwali mela in our town is bright and noisy. Rows of stalls sell sweets and clay diyas. Music plays from giant speakers late into the night.' (a) The giant wheel ride costs thirty rupees. (b) For one week every year, the mela fills our town with joy. (c) My cousin lives in Pune.
prompt.hi: Is paragraph ke liye best closing line chuno: 'The Diwali mela in our town is bright and noisy. Rows of stalls sell sweets and clay diyas. Music plays from giant speakers late into the night.' (a) The giant wheel ride costs thirty rupees. (b) For one week every year, the mela fills our town with joy. (c) My cousin lives in Pune.

challenges.hint: It comes back to the main idea, the mela, instead of adding one more small fact.

options.text: (a) The giant wheel ride costs thirty rupees.
(b) For one week every year, the mela fills our town with joy.

challenges.keyText: (b) For one week every year, the mela fills our town with joy.
